queries_run: Silicon Motion SIMO third quarter 2026 results revenue growth client SSD controller enterprise
NAND flash demand outlook 2027 SSD controller market share pricing trend

findings.claim: SIMO 2026Q3 淨銷售 $560.2M，季增 24%、年增 131%，高於財測區間 $519–541M；SSD controller 銷售季增 20–25%、年增 55–60%（來自搜尋摘要轉述，未逐字核對）
SIMO Q2 call：MonTitan 企業級 SSD 已與兩家 Tier 1 客戶進入量產，預期下半年另五家 Tier 1 客戶開始放量
TrendForce 預期 NAND 供需 2027 下半年趨於平衡，2026 供給缺口約 4–6%；伺服器為主要需求成長來源
findings.source: Guru3D: NAND flash supply expected to return to market balance in 2027

findings.claim: SIMO 表示 NAND 短缺下 SSD 廠可能縮減容量以滿足出貨量，仍需採購控制器；預期 2027 供給更緊
findings.source: Tom's Hardware: Silicon Motion increases sales of SSD controllers amid NAND shortage
findings.excerpt: SSD makers may reduce the capacity of their drives to meet unit demand, which means that they will still buy SSD controllers and, in some cases, even increase their controller purchases.

note: 未取得 SSD controller 以外各營收段（如 eMMC/UFS、MonTitan 企業級）逐段數據與市佔數字；搜尋未見控制器廠市佔資料。 線索 3 條，程式核實 1 條，2 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
